entries.name: Niagara Component
entries.short_description: Component used to attach and control a Niagara System on an Actor.

properties.name: When to Use
properties.value: When VFX needs to exist on and follow an Actor.

properties.name: Performance Notes
properties.value:
- Do not keep too many Niagara Components active at once.
- Deactivate or destroy when the effect is finished.

properties.name: Related Concepts
properties.value:
Niagara System
Niagara Emitter
Spawn System Attached

entries.name: Gameplay Tag
entries.short_description: Hierarchical label used by Gameplay Ability System to identify states, events, and data.

properties.name: When to Use
properties.value: When you need a stable, hierarchical identifier instead of a raw string or enum.

properties.name: Related Concepts
properties.value:
Gameplay Ability
Gameplay Effect
Ability System Component

entries.name: Gameplay Ability
entries.short_description: GAS unit that represents an activatable action such as an attack, dash, or interact.

properties.name: When to Use
properties.value: When a character action needs prediction, tags, costs, cooldowns, and replication.

properties.name: Important Nodes
properties.value:
- Activate Ability
- Commit Ability
- End Ability
- Wait Target Data

properties.name: Related Concepts
properties.value:
Gameplay Effect
Gameplay Tag
Ability System Component

entries.name: Motion Warping
entries.short_description: Warps root motion during an Anim Montage so the character lands on a target location or rotation.

properties.name: When to Use
properties.value: Melee attacks, vaults, climbs, and interactions that must hit a precise point.

properties.name: Common Mistakes
properties.value:
- Forgetting to add a Motion Warping component.
- Warp window not covering the needed montage section.
- Target transform not updated before the warp window.

entries.name: Anim Montage
entries.short_description: Playable animation asset with sections, notifies, and blending used for one-shot actions.

properties.name: When to Use
properties.value: Attacks, hit reactions, interactions, and other actions that should interrupt locomotion.

properties.name: Related Concepts
properties.value:
Anim Notify
Motion Warping
Linked Anim Graph

entries.name: Primary Data Asset
entries.short_description: Asset-backed UObject used to store designer-facing data that can be referenced by other assets.

properties.name: When to Use
properties.value: Ability definitions, item tables, and any data that should live as an editor asset instead of a raw struct.

entries.name: Behavior Tree
entries.short_description: Tree of tasks and decorators that drives AI decision making together with a Blackboard.

entries.name: StateTree
entries.short_description: Data-driven hierarchical state machine often used as a modern alternative or complement to Behavior Trees.

properties.name: When to Use
properties.value: When AI or gameplay logic is easier to express as states and transitions than as a pure BT.
